name: SpeakUpCaseManager
tagline: Every whistleblowing report acknowledged, investigated independently and answered on time – without ever exposing the reporter.
description: A complete speak-up and whistleblowing case app for ethics, compliance and legal teams: anonymous and confidential intake with identity protection, acknowledgement and feedback clocks per deadline rule (EU Whistleblowing Directive, UK PIDA, SOX / Dodd-Frank, local policy) with extension limits, triage and severity, conflict-of-interest checks, an investigation plan with evidence counts, a reporter mailbox that blocks names of subjects, findings with remediation, ethics committee sign-off, generated feedback, retaliation check-ins and on-time reporting – for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Acknowledgement and feedback clocks per deadline rule (configurable, e.g. 7 days + 3 months)
Anonymous reports never store a name; confidential identities masked
Conflict-of-interest checks for investigators, step owners and sign-off approvers
Investigation plan with owners, due dates and evidence items
Reporter mailbox that blocks messages naming subjects
Findings, remediation actions and ethics committee sign-off rules
17 automatic checks and P1–P4 priority from severity and deadlines
Bulk assignment (conflicts skipped), CSV export with masked identities, undo
Phone layout with bottom view switcher (375/360/320 px)
Power Fx outputs and OnSelect / OnChange / OnCreate / OnSave / OnAction / OnStatusChange events
react: 16.14.0 bundled (no platform libraries, no Fluent UI)
controlType: standard (SpeakUpCaseManager data-set control + SpeakUpCaseManagerPortal field control)
